about_the_game:
If you are a fan of Back to the Dawn and want to support its developers, please consider purchasing this Supporter Pack DLC and giving them a boost on this gamedev journey!

The Supporter Pack DLC contains:

  • Two Special-Edition Dice Skins: Ace Reporter and Night Owl.

  • Instant Photo: You can enable the protagonists's unique emoji in Settings.

  • Cell Decoration Bundle: Includes three cell skins — Golden Wind, Breath of the Forest, and Disco Ball.

  • "Infernal Hero" Poster: Increases Reputation by 5 each night when placed in your cell, up to 5 nights.

  • "Floodlight" Poster: Increases Rapport with all inmates by 3 each night when placed in your cell, up to 5 nights.

  • "Hidden Room" Movie CD-ROM: Playable on computers in the General Building; no skill effects, but provides a unique 4D viewing experience.

  • "Zoo Breaker" Audio Cassette: Features the original Early Access main menu music, selectable in the settings.

  • Back to the Dawn Concept Art Collection
